# GateLink — Complete Product & System Architecture Documentation

> GateLink (https://gatelink.in) is India's leading unified Operating System for Apartment Housing Societies, Residential Welfare Associations (RWAs), and Gated Communities.

---

## 1. Executive Product Summary
GateLink replaces disconnected paper visitor registers, manual WhatsApp payment chasing, physical logbooks, and fragmented spreadsheets with a single, cloud-native platform connecting:
- **Residents & Owners** (via Flutter Mobile App)
- **Security Guards & Gate Staff** (via Flutter Guard Mobile App)
- **Management Committees & RWA Treasurers** (via React Web Dashboard at app.gatelink.in)
- **System Super Administrators** (via React Control Portal at admin.gatelink.in)

---

## 2. Core Functional Modules

### 2.1 Society Management & Governance ERP
- **Digital Resident Directory**: Strict role-based unit association (Owner, Tenant, Family Member) with vehicle license plate mapping and tenant verification logs.
- **Official AGM & Polls System**: Conduct Annual General Body Meetings, voting resolutions, and rule changes with strict 1-vote-per-flat or 1-vote-per-member governance rules.
- **Facility & Clubhouse Booking**: Configurable booking slots for clubhouses, tennis courts, banquet halls, and swimming pools with automated deposit tracking and cancellation policies.
- **Helpdesk & Ticket Desk**: SLA-driven ticket management for plumbing, electrical, security, and general maintenance with photo attachments and resident satisfaction ratings.
- **Digital Notice Board**: Categorized broadcast bulletins with push notifications, read receipts, and priority alerts for water/power maintenance schedules.
- **Emergency SOS Broadcast**: Instant resident-to-gate and guard-to-resident SOS alarms with physical location and flat details.

### 2.2 Visitor Management System
- **Pre-Approved Invites**: Residents create guest passes with 4-digit PINs or QR codes sent via WhatsApp/SMS for contactless gate check-in.
- **Delivery Management**: Automated quick check-in for Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy, Zomato, Blinkit, and courier agents with resident passcodes or 'Leave at Gate' confirmations.
- **Cab & Ride-Hailing Entry**: Uber/Ola driver vehicle number verification with time-bounded entry permissions.
- **Frequent Visitors & Daily Staff**: Domestic helper, driver, cleaner, and cook attendance logging using QR biometric cards with instant resident arrival alerts.
- **Vehicle Access Control**: Fast vehicle registration number lookup, parking slot validation, and unauthorized vehicle tagging.

### 2.3 Accounting & Maintenance Billing
- **Automated Monthly Invoicing**: Generate itemized maintenance bills with custom formulas (per sq. ft. rate, fixed unit rate, or hybrid tier).
- **GST & SAC Compliance**: Fully compliant with SAC 999598 (RWA Services) and Indian GST laws, including standard ₹7,500/month exemption thresholds.
- **Payment Gateway Integration**: Embedded Cashfree Payments gateway supporting instant UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking (50+ Indian banks), Debit/Credit Cards.
- **Automated Reconciliation**: Real-time webhook processing immediately marks invoices as PAID and automatically issues computer-generated GST tax receipts.
- **Offline & Cheque Recording**: Treasurer dashboard to verify and approve cash/cheque/NEFT receipts with maker-checker audit controls.
- **Dues Management & Penalties**: Configurable late payment grace periods, percentage/flat penalty interest, and automated WhatsApp/SMS due reminders.

### 2.4 Security Management & Guard App
- **High-Speed Gate Entry**: Under 15-second entry verification optimized for low-end Android smartphones (Android 8.0+).
- **Offline-First Resilience**: Local caching allows guards to verify pre-approved guest codes and record physical visitor photos even during broadband drops.
- **Guard Patrol Tracking**: Night security patrols verified via geo-tagged, timestamped QR checkpoints mounted throughout the society perimeter.
- **Shift Handover Logs**: Digital logbook documenting gate incidents, visitor pass counts, and guard shift changeovers.

---

## 3. Data Privacy & Compliance (DPDP Act 2023)
GateLink is built in strict adherence to India's **Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023**:
- **Data Minimization**: Only strictly necessary personal data (name, phone, unit number) is collected for residential safety and billing.
- **Right to Erasure & Deletion**: Residents and guards can request permanent account deletion via our self-serve portal (`https://gatelink.in/delete-account`).
- **Data Retention Boundaries**: Visitor phone logs and security CCTV references are retained only for society security audit windows (typically 90–180 days) before automated purging.
- **Statutory Financial Records**: Maintenance tax invoices and GST records are archived in compliance with Indian accounting laws.
- **Encryption Standards**: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 vault storage with isolated multi-tenant database rules.

---

## 4. Technology Stack
- **Frontend Web Portals**: React 18, Vite, Vanilla CSS Design System with GateLink tokens.
- **Mobile Applications**: Flutter 3.x (Resident App & Guard App) with Riverpod state management.
- **Backend**: Firebase Cloud Functions v2 (Node.js serverless microservices) and Cloud Firestore with multi-tenant security rules.
- **Authentication**: Firebase Phone Auth (SMS OTP) with invisible reCAPTCHA Enterprise and custom token verification.
- **Payments**: Cashfree Payments SDK with secure webhook signing.
- **Push Notifications**: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) multi-channel notification system.

---

## 5. Pricing & Deployment
- **Standard Tier**: ₹15 per flat / month for communities up to 100 flats.
- **Premium Tier**: ₹20 per flat / month with full accounting, gate management, and patrol tracking.
- **Enterprise Tier**: ₹25 per flat / month with dedicated account manager, on-site guard onboarding, and custom ERP integrations.
- **Trial**: 14-day free pilot for any registered housing society in India without setup fees.
